thread:
sophia: Hi @people-ops, quick heads up — my family is relocating to Auckland (NZ) for ~8 months starting June. Need to change my homebase. Questions: payroll cutover impact? WFH stipend continuity/proration? benefits (health/insurance) while abroad? Any notice period? Thanks :wave:

marta: congrats! :tada: Please fill the relocation request form and add the expected NZ start/end dates so we can kick things off.

marta: Short answers — payroll: likely a cutover to our NZ payroll partner depending on tax review (timeline ~60 days). WFH stipend: we prorate monthly allowance while you're away. Benefits: depends on local coverage; we'll coordinate with benefits vendor.

sophia: Appreciate it. Visa/work permit is via spouse (no company sponsorship). Any docs we need to sign from my side?

oliver (Payroll): FYI if tax residency switches we need local tax forms. Please share expected move date + proposed NZ residential address. We'll run withholding and net pay simulations.

oliver (Payroll): Proration rule we use (example):
```
stipend_prorated = round(monthly_stipend * days_in_country / days_in_month)
```

marta: Note on equipment shipping: we can arrange shipping but customs/GST on import may be payable by the employee for NZ in many cases. We'll provide options.

lina (Legal): Confirm right-to-work. If you remain on Redwood (US) payroll while physically in NZ for extended period, we need a legal/payroll risk review. Send details.

people-ops-bot: relocation-checklist.pdf — https://rwd.internal/people-ops/relocation-checklist (automated)

james (Manager): happy to support — we can adjust on-call/meetings. let me know if you want any schedule changes.

sophia: Thanks. I'll fill the form today. Expected dates: leave US 2024-06-15, arrive NZ 2024-06-17, return ~2025-02-15.

marta: Got it. I'll start benefits + payroll intake. Expect a follow-up from payroll in 2–3 business days.

oliver (Payroll): We'll need a signed consent for payroll data transfer + passport copy + address proof. I'll DM the exact checklist.

lina (Legal): Also will need to know whether you'll open a local bank account if/when we cutover payroll.

sophia: One last Q: will the WFH stipend cover coworking membership while abroad?

marta: Stipend policy covers "home office" broadly. For long relocations we evaluate coworking requests case-by-case — please add a note in the form and attach receipts.

sophia: Form submitted (relocation form ID: 1719994444).

james (Manager): :thumbsup:

marta: follow-up note from payroll: they requested last US paystub + completed tax forms. Short checklist here:
• relocation form (done)
• passport copy
• local address
• last US paystub
• applicable tax forms
• signed consent for data transfer
• expected return date

oliver (Payroll): Intake call scheduled for Friday 10am PT — invite sent.

sophia: Got the invite, thanks.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: submit receipts within 30 days for stipend reimbursement. https://rwd.internal/people-ops/wfh-stipend-policy

marta: Closing loop — payroll will confirm proration numbers after simulation. If anything else comes up tag me here.

sophia: Thanks team :heart:
